task: Rollback union-find plus offline dynamic connectivity (divide and conquer over time)
reasoning_summary: Union by size without path compression makes each merge a single reversible stack entry. Offline connectivity turns edge lifetimes into intervals over the event timeline, spreads them over a segment tree and DFSes it, applying edges on entry and rolling back on exit. Tests: unit, validation, 300 randomised timelines vs a BFS oracle, and a 20k-event timed run; all passed first try.
